info.about: Grandia II is a role-playing video game developed by Game Arts originally for the Dreamcast console as part of their Grandia series. Initially released in Japan by Game Arts in August 2000, the game was published by Ubi Soft in North America in December 2000 and in Europe in February 2001.
info.trivia: Game Arts' sequel arrived on Dreamcast first; the later PS2 port ran worse and was widely panned.
info.why: Dreamcast RPGs are few, the port is considered the definitive one, and the small US print run went out of stock as Sega left the hardware business.
